51604273.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 chip-immobilized LC3B (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The compound was dissolved in DMSO to prepare a concentrated solution of 5 mM. Subsequently, it was diluted with HBS-EP + buffer (Cytiva) to the desired concentrations (19.5 nM–5 μM), ensuring the sample remained clear and precipitation-free. The NLRP3 protein (Cusabio) and LC3B protein (Sinobiochemical) were immobilized on a CM5 chip (Cytiva) for surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis of compound binding at different concentrations. The chip was thoroughly washed, and regeneration was performed.

original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. MC-ND-18 degrades NLRP3 through the autophagic lysosomal pathway. (A) Affinity testing of MC-ND-18 with NLRP3 protein (lacking the LRR structural domain) and LC3B protein. (B) Western blot of THP-1 cells treated with 500 nM MC-ND-18, NLRP3/LC3B warheads and co-treatment for 24 h. (C) The fluorescence colocalization of NLRP3-LC3B. THP-1 cells were treated with 500 nM MC-ND-18 for 4 h for NLRP3-LC3B colocalization. Note that the colocalization analysis was performed using the Coloc 2 program in ImageJ to obtain 2D intensity histograms and Pearson correlation coefficients. (D) Changes in NLRP3 protein levels in THP-1 cells co-incubated with compound MC-ND-18 and autophagy inhibitors or inducers for 24 h after induced by LPS for 24 h *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, n = 3. (E) Changes in NLRP3 protein levels in THP-1 cells co-incubated with compound MC-ND-18 and proteasome inhibitor MG132 for 24 h after induced by LPS for 24 h *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, n = 3.
